name: @veyq/core-js
//: The Kotlin core (src/mobile/core) compiled for JavaScript, ADR 0155 decisions 3 and 6: Gradle compiles (`build`, which runs the core's `:core:jsPackage` and writes `dist/`, never committed), pnpm installs, bundles and tests. Its primitives are the web's own @noble/*, at @veyq/crypto's ranges so the lockfile holds one version of each. Its check runs the suite's conformance over contracts/crypto/vectors/v1.json under Node, from a binary of its own (`dist/conformance/`), never an export of the shipped module. Nothing is exported yet: each application's façade becomes one entry when it moves (ADR 0155 decision 5), and nothing under src/web/ imports this package before cr-web-expenses-on-the-core.

scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
